slides.subtitle: Count four reels in one X-ray shot, sync MES, print the new label
slides.notes: Sources: X3100 brochure; English operation manual chapter 6.

slides.title: The stock count is wrong long before the line stops
slides.lead: A reel that says 5,000 on its label and holds 1,200 is invisible until a feeder runs empty in the middle of a job.

cards.h: Lines stop for parts the system says you have
cards.b: Partly used reels return with the original label quantity; MES plans the next job on a number that is no longer true.

cards.h: Counting costs labour and opens sensitive packs
cards.b: Tape-wheel counters handle one reel at a time; every opening adds handling, ESD and moisture exposure.
Cycle counts need a quantity per reel ID. Without a fast count the warehouse writes estimates.

slides.caption: Four reels on the tray in the marked counting positions
slides.notes: Pain points from the X3100 brochure positioning; no customer data.

slides.title: Four steps from reel to correct label

steps.b: Place 1 - 4 reels, trays, tubes or bags in the marked positions and press both start buttons.
The closed tube and 3072 x 3072 px flat panel image all reels through tape and cover.
Software counts every reel; the 20 MP camera reads all barcodes and matches quantity to reel ID.
Result saved (TXT / CSV / XLS), sent to MES, ERP or WMS and printed as a new 60 x 40 mm label.
